claims.text: Offensive content includes hate speech, cyberbullying, cyber-aggression, toxic comments, and abusive language.
Offensive content can be categorized into targeted insults (TIN) and untargeted profanity (UNT).
Targets of offensive content can be individuals (IND), groups (GRP), or other entities (OTH).
